p2_v4_epoch16_20260808.summary: Under endpoint_v4 the estimand (publication-block macro over the 8 non-degenerate publications) is now IDENTIFIABLE, but the best learned model (p2_mlp) incremental delta over the trivial baseline is +0.0298 with paired publication-block bootstrap delta CI lower bound -0.0833 (does NOT exclude 0) and the publication-block permutation is degenerate (unique block sizes, zero power). Incremental cross-publication learnability on the primary binary-changer estimand is NOT established. Verdict STOP (fail-closed); Phase 3 architecture iteration remains BLOCKED.

p2_epoch17_routeC_position_granularity_2.permutation_p: 1.0 for ALL models and ALL 5 seeds (publication-block permutation)
p2_epoch17_routeC_position_granularity_2.summary: Even at position granularity (each publication contributes thousands of position units, tightening the paired bootstrap CI so that logistic/MLP delta CI lower > 0), the publication-block permutation test gives p=1.0 for every model and every seed. The positive delta (+0.04 AUPRC over trivial) is NOT distinguishable from the within-publication signal reachable by permuting scores among equal-size publications. Incremental cross-publication learnability on the position-level binary-changer estimand is NOT established. Verdict STOP (fail-closed); Phase 3 architecture iteration remains BLOCKED.

upgrade_path.phase2_unblock: Three endpoints (v3 pair-level UNIDENTIFIABLE; v4 pair-level IDENTIFIABLE low-power; v5 position-granularity IDENTIFIABLE but permutation p=1.0) all fail to establish incremental cross-publication learnability of the mutation-induced reactivity response. Phase 2 remains NOT established. Further unblock requires either (a) raw per-replicate counts archive to rerun DirectClamp vs WithinReplicateCount kill test, or (b) a new endpoint/estimand under a new authority epoch with explicit user authorization.
